antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 810nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in tenocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Frequency sweep: 447->370->306 THz descending scan, 10^-13s per step, 5 cycles targeting cytochrome_c_oxidase in tenocyte.
